name: The Ashenvale Hunt
summary: Warcaller Gorlach sends the Horde north into Ashenvale to join the hunt. Report to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, where the Horde is pushing its frontier into the ancient forest.

sections.title: Call of the Wilds
sections.body: Orgrimmar needs timber, meat, and safe trade routes to keep growing. Warcaller Gorlach carries orders from the Horde's high command, sending seasoned wanderers and new adventurers toward active campaigns. For those coming of age in Durotar and the Barrens, Ashenvale is the next test of skill and survival.

sections.title: A Treacherous Frontier
sections.body: North of the Barrens, Ashenvale holds two Horde strongholds. Splintertree Post lies in the eastern woods, while Zoram'gar Outpost stands along the western coast. Senani Thunderheart coordinates operations from Splintertree Post, organizing trackers and hunters to face the beasts beneath the canopy and night elven sentinels who contest the Horde's claims.

faq.q: Who starts this quest and where can I find them?
faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach gives the order in Orgrimmar, the Horde capital. He calls capable adventurers to campaigns beyond Durotar.
Splintertree Post lies north of the Barrens in eastern Ashenvale, along the main forest road east toward Azshara.
Senani Thunderheart is a seasoned tauren tracker at Splintertree Post. She directs the hunt across Ashenvale and judges adventurers seeking to join the local trials.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Ashenvale hunt?
faq.answer: The hunt secures wild game and valuable hides, and removes apex predators that threaten patrols near Splintertree Post and nearby logging operations.

faq.q: What other outposts does the Horde hold in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde also holds Zoram'gar Outpost on the far western edge of Ashenvale, along the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any combat?
aliases: is there fighting in this quest
faq.answer: No. You travel from Orgrimmar through the Barrens to report to Senani Thunderheart; the journey itself calls for no combat.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry its reach beyond Durotar into resource-rich but hostile foreign lands.
As a hunter, you find a proving ground in Ashenvale's dense canopy and dangerous beasts when you answer Senani Thunderheart's call.
As a tauren, you can bring your deep reverence for the great hunt to the untamed forest under Senani Thunderheart's direction.
